Title: About — Glinto
Description: How Glinto works and what we do: brand strategy, film and photography, design, web and app development, and AI in expert hands.
About — Glinto
About Glinto
Creative studio for
Identity · Visuals · and Code
Built on three areas, brand strategy, design and media, and engineering, Glinto covers the whole of building a brand.
Core value
We carry your brand's own value in one consistent direction, and make it clear.
Clearly
With a sharp eye, we find the story your brand wants to tell and put it in order.
In one voice
From logo and website to packaging and social, we bring every part of the brand under one standard, so together they express a single brand value.
Distinctly
We look for the story only your brand has, down to its makers' convictions and taste and the details in the product. Then we design so that this value shows clearly in every part.
Something new
We are open to work that doesn't fit a set category. If it's creative, we're in, whatever the format.
Services
What we do
Specialists in brand strategy, media, design and development work together.
Pick only the services you need to start a project.

We study the market and competing brands to set your brand's direction and message.
From naming to logo, color and guidelines, we build one consistent identity.

Safer AI, in the hands of experts
Glinto cares about using AI accurately before using it fast. Your materials are handled under strict security rules, and every result is checked by an expert.
Early MVP builds
We build the first version you need to test your idea, quickly. AI speeds up the work, while our development team designs the core features and structure itself, building a service that can run for the long term.
Maintenance for services built with AI
Even a service started with vibe coding needs bug fixes and better features once its users grow. Our development team studies the existing code, improves it, and brings the service to a finished standard.

Answering customers, searching internal documents, handling repetitive work: we design and build AI agents around your company's data and the way you work.
